mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (comment_id, user_id, video_id, parent_id, reply_to_user_id, content, like_count, status) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{userId}, #{videoId}, #{parentId}, #{replyToUserId}, #{content}, #{likeCount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, comment_id AS commentId, user_id AS userId, video_id AS videoId, parent_id AS parentId, reply_to_user_id AS replyToUserId, content, like_count AS likeCount, status, create_time AS createTime FROM comment WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.comment_id, c.user_id, c.video_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_to_user_id, ru.nickname AS reply_to_nickname, c.content, c.like_count, c.status, c.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user ru ON c.reply_to_user_id = ru.user_id WHERE c.video_id = #{videoId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.comment_id, c.user_id, c.video_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_to_user_id, COALESCE(ru.nickname, ru2.nickname) AS reply_to_nickname, c.content, c.like_count, c.status, c.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user ru ON c.reply_to_user_id = ru.user_id LEFT JOIN comment root ON c.parent_id = root.comment_id LEFT JOIN user ru2 ON root.user_id = ru2.user_id WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE video_id = #{videoId}
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
UPDATE comment SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
UPDATE comment SET status = 1 WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
UPDATE comment SET status = 0 WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
